name: npr-test_goo_scene_color_position_filter
purpose: Verify that Filter material Scene Color with source POSITION returns correctly aligned world-space position data, including at non-64-multiple render sizes that exercise HiZ padding.
passCriteria: The test must keep scene_color.source set to POSITION, render a 257x257 Eevee image, decode Scene Color(Position) X/Z from filter output, and confirm the center plus multiple off-center samples are within 0.03 world units of the orthographic camera's expected world positions.
